outcome: Every primary workflow in the production workout app executes from the visible UI, including a workout that can advance through rest, resume, and finish without trapping the user.
non_goals: Keeping synthetic QA food, workout, or body-weight records
constraints: Preserve user-created data and remove all temporary QA records
Use test-first fixes for every reproduced defect
Keep fixes focused and compatible with the existing Vercel project
Stop after three failed hypotheses for one defect and report the architectural blocker

success_checks.command_or_condition: npm test && npm run test:auth && npm run build
Today, Train, Food, Progress, and Coach pages all open from production navigation without a console or runtime failure.
A production workout can start, record a set, show and control rest, advance to the next actionable set, resume after navigation or reload, and finish or cancel with an explicit visible control.
Food search, AI estimate, and manual entry controls execute; a temporary record can be created and removed without changing existing user records.
Progress renders and its temporary body-weight entry workflow validates, saves, and cleans up safely if deletion is supported.
Coach accepts one bounded test prompt and renders a successful response.
The GitHub main deployment is READY and verified production requests have no failed runtime status codes.

stop_conditions: All required success checks have fresh evidence
A user-only credential or platform action blocks the same check three times
Three repair hypotheses fail for one defect
required_evidence: Failing and passing regression test output for each repaired defect
Fresh full test and production build output
In-app browser observations for every primary page and workout lifecycle state
Final Vercel deployment and runtime-log evidence
Clean Git worktree and remote main commit
approval_boundaries: Do not expose or modify secrets
Create only clearly temporary QA records and remove them when the UI supports removal
Deploy only to the existing workout-app production project
